claim_checks.claim: EBIT margin before special items FY2025/26 '25-26% (sources conflict) vs 28% prior year'
claim_checks.finding: AR 2025/26 five-year table: EBIT before special items DKK7,447m on revenue DKK28,941m = 25.7% (company rounds to 26%) vs DKK7,670m/27,874m = 27.5% (rounded 28%) in 2024/25. Special items -DKK3,195m (Kerecis-related) -> reported EBIT margin 15%. FY2026/27 guidance: organic 5-7%, EBIT margin before special items 'around 25%' in constant currencies (TARGET). FY2025/26 guidance had been cut on 23/24-Apr-2026 to organic 5-6% (from ~7%) and cc EBIT growth ~5%, Kerecis growth expectation reset from ~25% to ~0%; actual 6% organic hit the top of the revised range.

Neither the AR 2025/26 nor the FY announcement mentions VBP or quantifies China revenue. China headwinds disclosed are (i) Ostomy Care channel destocking from a new sales-channel strategy in H2 2025/26 (Ostomy organic 5% vs 7% ex-China) and (ii) an Advanced Wound Dressings product return in China initiated in Q3 2024/25. China sits within Emerging markets (17% of revenue, all EM). Company is 'rightsizing' its China organisation and resetting the China baseline in FY26/27 guidance. Treat China as a small, currently negative contributor; VBP-specific exposure is not evidenced.

claim_checks.claim: Louis-Hansen family/foundation control majority of votes
claim_checks.finding: At 30-Sep-2026 Niels Peter Louis-Hansen controlled (via NPLH Holding/Coloplast Holding) 29.49% of capital and 51.36% of votes. On 1-Oct-2026 NPLH Holding gifted its Coloplast Holding shares to Coloplast Fonden (via CF Holding af 2026 ApS), so control now sits with a foundation rather than the individual (see AR ownership section for exact post-transfer percentages).
